about_the_game:
Embark on a thrilling adventure in Pre Dusk, a captivating journey into darkness. Play as Ray, a determined youth escaping his grandfather's mysterious home. Master weapons and abilities like gliding and grappling to overcome challenges and foes. Uncover secrets, interact with intriguing characters, and navigate diverse environments.

The world of Predusk is rich with its characters and natural diversity where each level brings new visual experiences and gameplay challenges.

- Use multiple weapons

- Unlock new abilities at every level [Gliding, double jump, Grappling, Crossbow]

- Explore the natural diversity

- Classic side-scrolling action, with all the modern art style.

-Fight your way through dozens of creatures who want to stop you.

- explore secret rooms.

- The controls are simple and accessible - simply jump, Attack, Swim, and double jump, Where you can use your controller for the best experience.

- Talk to different characters and face difficult challenges.

Each aspect of the game art and characters is hand-drawn with passion and regard to the world and lore of the game.


Explore a haunting black and white 2D world filled with dark caves and face off against a fearsome crow boss in this intense platforming adventure


Brave the icy depths of Brain Freeze, a cold blue level filled with stunning landscapes, treacherous ice caves, and challenging enemies in this action-packed adventure.


Step into the misty and mysterious Foggy Forest where you'll encounter weird characters, battle a formidable tree boss, and conquer diverse platforming challenges in this green forest game level.


Jump into the dangers of the Savage Sands, a sand desert level filled with ancient castles, tough platforming, and fearsome sandworm enemies, in this exciting adventure.


In the final showdown at Castle Rain, you'll face the game's most powerful character and his formidable castle guard enemies while navigating challenging platforming in this intense last level.
